result.summary: Found 2 visual issues on the food delivery app page: one major layout truncation issue and one minor missing element.

issues.description: The 'Trattoria Piccol...' restaurant card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off on the right side — both the image and the restaurant name are truncated, making it unclear to the user that this is a scrollable section.
issues.suggestion: Add a visible scroll indicator, arrow, or partial card peek with a clear affordance to signal horizontal scrollability. Ensure the truncated text has an ellipsis and that the card peek is intentional and consistent in design.

issues.description: The second restaurant card in 'Fastest near you' (Smash Bros Burgers) does not show a delivery price label below the name, unlike the other two cards which show '€0.90 delivery' and '€1.90 delivery' respectively.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent display of delivery fee information across all restaurant cards in the horizontal scroll list.
